title: Correlation of Sound and Colour
author: Paul Foster Case
imprint: Set from the School's typed text. Rosicrucian Developers, 2026
edition: The typed text, as the School issued it; the typescript is undated
publicDomain: Paul Foster Case died in 1954. A text issued privately to the School's students and never published was, under US law, in copyright for seventy years after his death: in the public domain since 1 January 2025. (If the School printed it for sale, the term runs instead from that printing: to be confirmed.)
note: Set from the School's typed text, contributed by Tony DeLuce, as transcribed and corrected for agelesswisdom.school (that site's repository, rosicrucian-dev/agelesswisdom, holds the work of reading it in), and brought here in October 2026 with the words unchanged (editorial/port.py). The four diagrams follow the text as a supplement.
